meta.name: Mascarade
meta.description: They've starred in tons of movies. He hasn't seen a single one. Welcome to Mascarade, where Monsieur Loris must unmask French cinema stars.

videos.title: Masquerade
videos.overview: Welcome to the first episode of Masquerade! And to think everyone on this show has actual responsibilities in real life…

videos.title: Disarrayed
videos.overview: Funny how the saying "Only the good ones go first" doesn't always quite apply…

videos.title: Betrayed
videos.overview: Divided factions, broken pacts, endless ego wars… What if Masquerade were just an exaggerated mirror of our own society?

videos.title: Manipulated
videos.overview: Careful! Just two episodes left to enjoy the very worst sides of human nature…

videos.title: Chosen
videos.overview: A little one isn't a big one, and a big one isn't a little one.
